target_customer: Sponsors and CROs running clinical trials
problem: Creating data collection forms, database designs and analysis outputs for a trial from the protocol is slow and costly. Baseline generated these from the protocol with AI.
business_model: B2B SaaS for trial sponsors, pricing not found
product_category: AI clinical trial document and data management

founders.name: Zoe Sheill
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; also participated in a clinical trial herself.

competitors.name: Yseop
competitors.what: Generative AI for clinical documents such as study reports and narratives

competitors.name: Research Grid
competitors.what: Automates clinical trial back-office admin including protocol generation and data extraction
competitors.funding_then: 6.5M dollar seed reported November 2024, a few months after the batch

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating forms, database models and analysis tables from a protocol needs domain data standards and validation, moderate with LLMs in 2024.

defensibility.rationale: Regulated clinical data workflows add some lock-in, but document generation was approachable for other AI entrants and the team was two people.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented. No source shows incumbents copying Baseline.

market_need_then: The launch post claims up to 18M dollars saved per phase 3 trial and 50 to 300 thousand dollars per lost trial day; the company description says 27M. These are company claims.

branding.domain_note: Uses baselinetrials.com, a descriptive suffix domain.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community found. Baseline is a generic word shared with Baseline Ventures and another Baseline AI profile.

outcome_analysis: YC page results show Baseline AI as active while Dealroom marks it closed and the dataset lists it inactive. No shutdown notice or cause was found, so the cause is not public. It raised about 500 thousand dollars and sold into a long enterprise clinical sales cycle with two people, but no source links these to the outcome.
notes: Website baselinetrials.com returned HTTP 503. The $500K pre-seed is reported by VCBacked (SBXi and YC) and CB Insights (convertible note, Sept 25 2024, YC only); Dealroom lists a 125K seed, a conflict. Status conflicts across sources. A separate Baseline AI profile about hospital early warning shares the domain in one aggregator and is likely wrong.
